_comment: Unified single-file spec for sim_theorem_partii.py (model folded inline). k=3, diagonal-Gram case (G∞ = I_k). factor_vols σ=[.16,.08,.06], idio vol 0.4 (δ²=.16). Effective spikes d_j = c_j·σ_j² = [0.0256, 0.00512, 0.00216] satisfy Assumption 3 (strict decrease).
_factor_vols_note: factor_vols are volatilities (squared into F). σ = [0.16, 0.08, 0.06].
_beta_samplers_note: Per-factor loading samplers. For the diagonal-Gram case, draw β_j ~ N(0, c_j) so ‖β_j‖²/p → c_j and off-diagonal Gram entries vanish. scale_j = √c_j with c = [1.0, 0.8, 0.6].
_idio_note: idio_vol_sampler value is a volatility (squared into D). 0.4 → δ² = 0.16.
